documentation.reviewed_scope: Guidance discovery, merge behavior, global overrides, custom home and troubleshooting. Navigation boilerplate is not evidence.
documentation.claim: Global guidance is read from CODEX_HOME; the documented separate-profile mechanism changes that home. The page does not establish a credentials-preserving opt-out from global guidance.

rejected_capture.reason: Redirected to a different URL; retained but not admitted. The canonical destination was then crawled directly.

observations: The reviewed Config and bootstrap AuthConfig constructors use the same codex_home as the instruction provider.
The app-server constructs its global instruction provider from config.codex_home.
Global and thread instruction contributions are separate fields; setting thread instructions does not remove the global field.
The project-document budget does not disable the native global provider.
decision: No supported unattended isolation route was established in the reviewed documentation and source paths. Keep existing admission rejection and the public launch refusal. This is a bounded investigation, not a proof that no supported route can exist.
next_step: Continue independent skill review and environment qualification. Reassess a documented official isolation mechanism or a separately authenticated clean profile only when available without changing the real user profile or requiring unattended user interaction.
